title: Arena's Max Router Matches Claude Fable 5.1 Performance at 37% Lower Cost
summary:
An agentic model router called Max now allows users to automatically select the most efficient AI model for a given task based on output quality and price. Developed by Arena and trained on 2.5M real-world agentic sessions, the tool recorded a 14.7% net improvement score in its internal benchmark. When routing tasks between Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT 6 Astra, Max matched the output of Fable 5.1 at a median cost of $3.27 per task, representing a 37% reduction in price.

The routing methodology works across various model combinations, shifting the performance-cost frontier for tasks involving code, chat, and work. For instance, pairing Fable 5 and Kimi K3 through Max resulted in a 10.7% net improvement and a 54% cost decrease compared to Fable 5 High, with costs dropping to $1.06 per task. Arena is currently providing direct access to the Fable 5.1 and Astra variant in Agent Mode and plans to release an API in the future.

Introducing our new agentic version of Max: Arena’s model router that achieves frontier-level performance at 37% lower cost.

Built on 2.5M real-world agentic sessions from Agent Arena, Max learns to dynamically select the best model for each task, optimizing for both performance and cost.

Max achieves a +14.7% net improvement score in Agent Arena at a median cost of $3.27 per task, matching the performance of Claude Fable 5.1 (Max) at 37% lower cost.

Try Max today for a limited time, and dive into more technical details in the thread.

Max shifts the performance–cost Pareto frontier in all three task categories in Agent Arena: Code, Chat, and Work.

The solid lines show the frontier with Max, compared with the dotted lines for public models alone. By routing between Fable 5.1 and GPT 6 Astra, Max delivers stronger results at a lower cost than any single frontier model.

selectedTweets.text:
We built Max’s routing methodology to work across any model combination, allowing the router to stay on the frontier even as new models launch.

With Fable 5 and Kimi K3, Max achieves a +10.7% net improvement at a median cost of $1.06 per task, outperforming Fable 5 (High) by 0.6 percentage points while reducing cost by 54%.

These results demonstrate how the same approach can improve the performance-cost frontier across different model combinations.
